sections.Profile:
"Up Away" is a space-themed electro-mechanical pinball machine released by the Spanish manufacturer Inder in 1975. The game accommodates a single player and features two flippers, three pop bumpers, and seven standup targets.

- Manufacturer: Inder
- Years made: 1975
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Space, 1970s, Fantasy, Sci-Fi
